products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a government research laboratory founded in 2020 and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. It is not for profit. Its Falcon product is a UAE-hosted open-source large language model under an Apache 2.0 license, positioned as sovereign AI with Middle East data residency.

The Falcon LLM family includes Falcon-H1, Falcon-E, Falcon Perception, Falcon Arabic, Falcon H1R 7B, Falcon Mamba 7B, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B, Falcon 40B, and Falcon 10B. The site states Falcon 180B has 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, and Falcon 40B has 40 billion parameters trained on one trillion tokens. It claims Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by Hugging Face Leaderboard. Falcon Mamba 7B is described as the first open source released State Space Language Model.

TII has launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models. AI71, launched by Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council and VentureOne, announced a call for proposals using Falcon 10B. No litigation, patent, or SEC filings are listed for the company.
